analysis.ai_privacy: Only totals per category and month are sent. Never notes or single transactions.

ai.title: AI commentary
ai.intro: Spicci computes every number itself. An AI model, if you want one, only writes a comment on top. Use any provider with an OpenAI-compatible API.
ai.trains: On the free tier this provider may use your requests to train its models.
ai.privacy: What is sent: income and expenses for the period and the previous one, totals per category, and the last 6 months. Never notes, tags, account names or single transactions.

lock.title: Lock with Face ID
lock.sub: Asks after 30 seconds away. The phone passcode always works too.
